sections.label: Book 23
sections.name: The Horse Sacrifice continued; the priests' riddles

verses.sa: हिरण्यगर्भः समवर्तताग्रे भूतस्य जातः पतिरेक आसीत्। स दाधार पृथिवीं द्यामुतेमां कस्मै देवाय हविषा विधेम॥
verses.tr: hiraṇyagarbhaḥ samavartatāgre bhūtasya jātaḥ patireka āsīt sa dādhāra pṛthivīṃ dyāmutemāṃ kasmai devāya haviṣā vidhema
verses.en: In the beginning rose. Hiranyagarbha,. etc.

verses.sa: उपयामगृहीतोऽसि प्रजापतये त्वा जुष्टं गृह्णाम्येष ते योनिः सूर्यस्ते महिमा। यस्तेऽहन्त्संवत्सरे महिमा सम्बभूव यस्ते वायावन्तरिक्षे महिमा सम्बभूव यस्ते दिवि सूर्ये महिमा सम्बभूव तस्मै ते महिम्ने प्रजापतये स्वाहा देवेभ्यः॥
verses.tr: upayāmagṛhīto'si prajāpataye tvā juṣṭaṃ gṛhṇāmyeṣa te yoniḥ sūryaste mahimā yaste'hantsaṃvatsare mahimā sambabhūva yaste vāyāvantarikṣe mahimā sambabhūva yaste divi sūrye mahimā sambabhūva tasmai te mahimne prajāpataye svāhā devebhyaḥ
verses.en: Taken upon a base art thou. I take thee welcome, to Prajapati. This, is thy place:, Surya thy majesty. The majesty that has accrued, to thee in the day, in a year, that majesty which has accrued in the wind, in the firmament, to that majesty of thine, to Prajapati,. to> the Gods, All-hail!

verses.sa: यः प्राणतो निमिषतो महित्वैक इद्राजा जगतो बभूव। य ईशे अस्य द्विपदश्चतुष्पदः कस्मै देवाय हविषा विधेम॥
verses.tr: yaḥ prāṇato nimiṣato mahitvaika idrājā jagato babhūva ya īśe asya dvipadaścatuṣpadaḥ kasmai devāya haviṣā vidhema
verses.en: Who by his grandeur hath become sole Ruler of all the moving world that breathes and slumbers.; He who is Sovran, of these men and cattle—what God shall we adore with our oblation?

verses.sa: उपयामगृहीतोऽसि प्रजापतये त्वा जुष्टं गृह्णाम्येष ते योनिश्चन्द्रमास्ते महिमा। यस्ते रात्रौ संवत्सरे महिमा सम्बभूव यस्ते पृथिव्यामग्नौ महिमा सम्बभूव यस्ते नक्षत्रेषु चन्द्रमसि महिमा सम्बभूव तस्मै ते महिम्ने प्रजापतये देवेभ्यः स्वाहा॥
verses.tr: upayāmagṛhīto'si prajāpataye tvā juṣṭaṃ gṛhṇāmyeṣa te yoniścandramāste mahimā yaste rātrau saṃvatsare mahimā sambabhūva yaste pṛthivyāmagnau mahimā sambabhūva yaste nakṣatreṣu candramasi mahimā sambabhūva tasmai te mahimne prajāpataye devebhyaḥ svāhā
verses.en: Taken upon a base a-rt thou. I take thee welcome to Prajapati. This is thy place: the Moon thy majesty. Thy majesty that has accrued to thee by night, in a year" thy majesty that, has accrued in the earth, in Agni, in the stars and in the Moon, to that> majesty of thine, to pati and to the Gods, All-hail!

verses.sa: युञ्जन्ति ब्रध्नमरुषं चरन्तं परि तस्थुषः। रोचन्ते रोचना दिवि॥
verses.tr: yuñjanti bradhnamaruṣaṃ carantaṃ pari tasthuṣaḥ rocante rocanā divi
verses.en: They who stand round him as he moves harness; the bright, the ruddy Steed,: The lights are shining in the sky.

verses.sa: युञ्जन्त्यस्य काम्या हरी विपक्षसा रथे। शोणा धृष्णू नृसाहसा॥
verses.tr: yuñjantyasya kāmyā harī vipakṣasā rathe śoṇā dhṛṣṇū nṛsāhasā
verses.en: On both sides to, the car they yoke the two Bay Coursers; dear to him, Bold, tawny, bearers of the Chief.

verses.sa: यद्वातो अपो अगनीगन्प्रियामिन्द्रस्य तन्वम्। एतं स्तोतरनेन पथा पुनरश्वमावर्तयासि नः॥
verses.tr: yadvāto apo aganīganpriyāmindrasya tanvam etaṃ stotaranena pathā punaraśvamāvartayāsi naḥ
verses.en: When, swift as; wind, the Horse has reached: the form, that Indra loves, the flood, Again, O singer, by this path bring thou.our Courser hither.

verses.sa: वसवस्त्वाञ्जन्तु गायत्रेण छन्दसा रुद्रास्त्वाञ्जन्तु त्रैष्टुभेन छन्दसा ऽऽदित्यास्त्वाञ्जन्तु जागतेन छन्दसा। भूर्भुवः स्वर्लाजी३ञ्छाची३न्यव्ये गव्य एतदन्नमत्त देवा एतदन्नमद्धि प्रजापते॥
verses.tr: vasavastvāñjantu gāyatreṇa chandasā rudrāstvāñjantu traiṣṭubhena chandasā ''dityāstvāñjantu jāgatena chandasā bhūrbhuvaḥ svarlājī3ñchācī3nyavye gavya etadannamatta devā etadannamaddhi prajāpate
verses.en: Let the Vasus anoint thee with Gayatri metre. Let the Rudras anoint thee with Trishtup metre. Let the Adityas anoint thee with Jagati metre. Earth! Ether! Heaven! O Gods, eat this food, parched grains and groats in the product net of barley and in the product of cows: eat this food, Prajapati.

verses.sa: कः स्विदेकाकी चरति क उ स्विज्जायते पुनः। किं स्विद्धिमस्य भेषजं किम्वावपनं महत्॥
verses.tr: kaḥ svidekākī carati ka u svijjāyate punaḥ kiṃ sviddhimasya bheṣajaṃ kimvāvapanaṃ mahat
verses.en: Who moveth single and alone? Who is brought forth to life again? Whatis the remedy of cold, or what the great receptacle?

verses.sa: सूर्य एकाकी चरति चन्द्रमा जायते पुनः। अग्निर्हिमस्य भेषजं भूमिरावपनं महत्॥
verses.tr: sūrya ekākī carati candramā jāyate punaḥ agnirhimasya bheṣajaṃ bhūmirāvapanaṃ mahat
verses.en: The Sun moves single and alone; The Moon is brought to life again. Fire is the remedy of cold;. Earth is the great receptacle:

verses.sa: का स्विदासीत्पूर्वचित्तिः किं स्विदासीद् बृहद्वयः। का स्विदासीत्पिलिप्पिला का स्विदासीत्पिशङ्गिला॥
verses.tr: kā svidāsītpūrvacittiḥ kiṃ svidāsīd bṛhadvayaḥ kā svidāsītpilippilā kā svidāsītpiśaṅgilā
verses.en: What was the antecedent thought: What was the bird of mighty size? The slippery matron, who was she? Who was the-reddish-coloured one?

verses.sa: द्यौरासीत्पूर्वचित्तिरश्व आसीद् बृहद्वयः। अविरासीत्पिलिप्पिला रात्रिरासीत्पिशङ्गिला॥
verses.tr: dyaurāsītpūrvacittiraśva āsīd bṛhadvayaḥ avirāsītpilippilā rātrirāsītpiśaṅgilā
verses.en: Heaven was the antecedent thought. The Courser was the mighty bird. The slippery matron was the earth. Night was the reddish-coloured one.

verses.sa: वायुष्ट्वा पचतैरवत्वसितग्रीवश्छागैर्न्यग्रोधश्चमसैः शल्मलिर्वृद्ध्या। एष स्य राथ्यो वृषा पड्भिश्चतुर्भिरेदगन्ब्रह्मा कृष्णश्च नोऽवतु नमोऽग्नये॥
verses.tr: vāyuṣṭvā pacatairavatvasitagrīvaśchāgairnyagrodhaścamasaiḥ śalmalirvṛddhyā eṣa sya rāthyo vṛṣā paḍbhiścaturbhiredaganbrahmā kṛṣṇaśca no'vatu namo'gnaye
verses.en: Vayu help thee with cooked viands! Blackneck with goats;: Nyagrodha with cups; ilraali with increase;: this Stallion here, good for the chariot—let him verily come with his four feet. Brahinakrishna help us! Obeisance to-Agni!

verses.sa: संशितो रश्मिना रथः संशितो रश्मिना हयः। संशितो अप्स्वप्सुजा ब्रह्मा सोमपुरोगवः॥
verses.tr: saṃśito raśminā rathaḥ saṃśito raśminā hayaḥ saṃśito apsvapsujā brahmā somapurogavaḥ
verses.en: The car is fitted with the rein, the steed is fitted with the rein. Fitted in waters, water-born, is Brahm following Soma's lead.

verses.sa: स्वयं वाजिँस्तन्वं कल्पयस्व स्वयं यजस्व स्वयं जुषस्व। महिमा तेऽन्येन न सन्नशे॥
verses.tr: svayaṃ vājiṃstanvaṃ kalpayasva svayaṃ yajasva svayaṃ juṣasva mahimā te'nyena na sannaśe
verses.en: Steed, from thy body, of thyself, sacrifice and accept thyself. Thy greatness can be gained by none but thee.

verses.sa: न वा उ एतन्म्रियसे न रिष्यसि देवाँ२ इदेषि पथिभिः सुगेभिः। यत्रासते सुकृतो यत्र ते ययुस्तत्र त्वा देवः सविता दधातु॥
verses.tr: na vā u etanmriyase na riṣyasi devāṃ2 ideṣi pathibhiḥ sugebhiḥ yatrāsate sukṛto yatra te yayustatra tvā devaḥ savitā dadhātu
verses.en: No, here thou diest not, thou art not injured; only by fair paths to the Gods thou goest. May Savitar the God in that world place thee where dwell the pious, whether they have journeyed.

verses.sa: अग्निः पशुरासीत्तेनायजन्त स एतँल्लोकमजयद्यस्मिन्नग्निः स ते लोको भविष्यति तं जेष्यसि पिबैता अपः। वायुः पशुरासीत्तेनायजन्त स एतँल्लोकमजयद्यस्मिन्वायुः स ते लोको भविष्यति तं जेष्यसि पिबैता अपः। सूर्यः पशुरासीत्तेनायजन्त स एतँल्लोकमजयद्यस्मिन्त्सूर्यः स ते लोको भविष्यति तं जेष्यसि पिबैता अपः॥
verses.tr: agniḥ paśurāsīttenāyajanta sa etaṃllokamajayadyasminnagniḥ sa te loko bhaviṣyati taṃ jeṣyasi pibaitā apaḥ vāyuḥ paśurāsīttenāyajanta sa etaṃllokamajayadyasminvāyuḥ sa te loko bhaviṣyati taṃ jeṣyasi pibaitā apaḥ sūryaḥ paśurāsīttenāyajanta sa etaṃllokamajayadyasmintsūryaḥ sa te loko bhaviṣyati taṃ jeṣyasi pibaitā apaḥ
verses.en: Agni was the victim. With him they sacrificed. He won this world in which Agni is. This shall become thy world. This shalt thou win. Drink these waters. Vayu was the victim. With him they sacrificed. He won this world in which Vayu is. This shall become, etc., as above. Surya was the victim, etc. He won the world in which Surya is. This shall become, etc.

verses.sa: प्राणाय स्वाहा ऽपानाय स्वाहा व्यानाय स्वाहा। अम्बे अम्बिकेऽम्बालिके न मा नयति कश्चन। ससस्त्यश्वकः सुभद्रिकां काम्पीलवासिनीम्॥
verses.tr: prāṇāya svāhā 'pānāya svāhā vyānāya svāhā ambe ambike'mbālike na mā nayati kaścana sasastyaśvakaḥ subhadrikāṃ kāmpīlavāsinīm
verses.en: To vital breath, Hail! To out-breathing, Hail! To diffusive breath. Hail! Ambi! Ambika! Ambalika! No one is taking me away. The sorry horse will lie beside another, as Subhadra the dweller in Kampila.

verses.sa: गणानां त्वा गणपतिं हवामहे प्रियाणां त्वा प्रियपतिं हवामहे निधीनां त्वा निधिपतिं हवामहे वसो मम। आहमजानि गर्भधमा त्वमजासि गर्भधम्॥
verses.tr: gaṇānāṃ tvā gaṇapatiṃ havāmahe priyāṇāṃ tvā priyapatiṃ havāmahe nidhīnāṃ tvā nidhipatiṃ havāmahe vaso mama āhamajāni garbhadhamā tvamajāsi garbhadham
verses.en: Rhee we invoke, troop-lord of troops. Thee we invoke, the loVed ones' lord. Thee, lord of treasures We invoke. My precious wealth! I,

verses.sa: ता उभौ चतुरः पदः संप्रसारयाव स्वर्गे लोके प्रोर्णुवाथां वृषा वाजी रेतोधा रेतो दधातु॥
verses.tr: tā ubhau caturaḥ padaḥ saṃprasārayāva svarge loke prorṇuvāthāṃ vṛṣā vājī retodhā reto dadhātu
verses.en: [Not translated by Griffith.]

verses.sa: उत्सक्थ्या अव गुदं धेहि समञ्जिं चारया वृषन्। य स्त्रीणां जीवभोजनः॥
verses.tr: utsakthyā ava gudaṃ dhehi samañjiṃ cārayā vṛṣan ya strīṇāṃ jīvabhojanaḥ
verses.en: [Not translated by Griffith.]

verses.sa: यकासकौ शकुन्तिकाऽऽहलगिति वञ्चति। आहन्ति गभे पसो निगल्गलीति धारका॥
verses.tr: yakāsakau śakuntikā''halagiti vañcati āhanti gabhe paso nigalgalīti dhārakā
verses.en: [Not translated by Griffith.]

verses.sa: यकोऽसकौ शकुन्तक आहलगिति वञ्चति। विवक्षत इव ते मुखमध्वर्यो मा नस्त्वमभि भाषथाः॥
verses.tr: yako'sakau śakuntaka āhalagiti vañcati vivakṣata iva te mukhamadhvaryo mā nastvamabhi bhāṣathāḥ
verses.en: [Not translated by Griffith.]

verses.sa: माता च ते पिता च तेऽग्रं वृक्षस्य रोहतः। प्रतिलामीति ते पिता गभे मुष्टिमतंसयत्॥
verses.tr: mātā ca te pitā ca te'graṃ vṛkṣasya rohataḥ pratilāmīti te pitā gabhe muṣṭimataṃsayat
verses.en: [Not translated by Griffith.]

verses.sa: माता च ते पिता च तेऽग्रे वृक्षस्य क्रीडतः। विवक्षत इव ते मुखं ब्रह्मन्मा त्वं वदो बहु॥
verses.tr: mātā ca te pitā ca te'gre vṛkṣasya krīḍataḥ vivakṣata iva te mukhaṃ brahmanmā tvaṃ vado bahu
verses.en: [Not translated by Griffith.]

verses.sa: ऊर्ध्वमेनामुच्छ्रापय गिरौ भारं हरन्निव। अथास्यै मध्यमेधतां शीते वाते पुनन्निव॥
verses.tr: ūrdhvamenāmucchrāpaya girau bhāraṃ haranniva athāsyai madhyamedhatāṃ śīte vāte punanniva
verses.en: [Not translated by Griffith.]

verses.sa: ऊर्ध्वमेनमुच्छ्रयताद्गिरौ भारं हरन्निव। अथास्य मध्यमेजतु शीते वाते पुनन्निव॥
verses.tr: ūrdhvamenamucchrayatādgirau bhāraṃ haranniva athāsya madhyamejatu śīte vāte punanniva
verses.en: [Not translated by Griffith.]

verses.sa: यदस्या अंहुभेद्याः कृधु स्थूलमुपातसत्। मुष्काविदस्या एजतो गोशफे शकुलाविव॥
verses.tr: yadasyā aṃhubhedyāḥ kṛdhu sthūlamupātasat muṣkāvidasyā ejato gośaphe śakulāviva
verses.en: [Not translated by Griffith.]

verses.sa: यद्देवासो ललामगुं प्र विष्टीमिनमाविषुः। सक्थ्ना देदिश्यते नारी सत्यस्याक्षिभुवो यथा॥
verses.tr: yaddevāso lalāmaguṃ pra viṣṭīminamāviṣuḥ sakthnā dediśyate nārī satyasyākṣibhuvo yathā
verses.en: [Not translated by Griffith.]

verses.sa: यद्धरिणो यवमत्ति न पुष्टं पशु मन्यते। शूद्रा यदर्यजारा न पोषाय धनायति॥
verses.tr: yaddhariṇo yavamatti na puṣṭaṃ paśu manyate śūdrā yadaryajārā na poṣāya dhanāyati
verses.en: [Not translated by Griffith.]

verses.sa: यद्धरिणो यवमत्ति न पुष्टं बहु मन्यते। शूद्रो यदर्यायै जारो न पोषमनु मन्यते॥
verses.tr: yaddhariṇo yavamatti na puṣṭaṃ bahu manyate śūdro yadaryāyai jāro na poṣamanu manyate
verses.en: [Not translated by Griffith.]

verses.sa: दधिक्राव्णो अकारिषं जिष्णोरश्वस्य वाजिनः। सुरभि नो मुखा करत्प्र ण आयूंषि तारिषत्॥
verses.tr: dadhikrāvṇo akāriṣaṃ jiṣṇoraśvasya vājinaḥ surabhi no mukhā karatpra ṇa āyūṃṣi tāriṣat
verses.en: Now have I glorified with praise strong Dadhikravan, conquering steed. SWeet may he make our mouths: may he prolong the days we have to live.

verses.sa: गायत्री त्रिष्टुब्जगत्यनुष्टुप्पङ्क्त्या सह। बृहत्युष्णिहा ककुप्सूचीभिः शम्यन्तु त्वा॥
verses.tr: gāyatrī triṣṭubjagatyanuṣṭuppaṅktyā saha bṛhatyuṣṇihā kakupsūcībhiḥ śamyantu tvā
verses.en: Glyatr, Trishtup, Jagati, and Pankti with Anushtup joined, Brihati, Kakup, lshniha pacify thee with needle-points!

verses.sa: द्विपदा याश्चतुष्पदास्त्रिपदा याश्च षट्पदाः। विच्छन्दा याश्च सच्छन्दाः सूचीभिः शम्यन्तु त्वा॥
verses.tr: dvipadā yāścatuṣpadāstripadā yāśca ṣaṭpadāḥ vicchandā yāśca sacchandāḥ sūcībhiḥ śamyantu tvā
verses.en: Two-footed, those that have four feet, those with three feet and those with five, Metreless, with one metre, these pacify thee with needle points!

verses.sa: महानाम्न्यो रेवत्यो विश्वा आशाः प्रभूवरीः। मैघीर्विद्युतो वाचः सूचीभिः शम्यन्तु त्वा॥
verses.tr: mahānāmnyo revatyo viśvā āśāḥ prabhūvarīḥ maighīrvidyuto vācaḥ sūcībhiḥ śamyantu tvā
verses.en: May Mahanamnis, Revatis, all far-spread Regions of the sky. Voices, and lightnings from the cloud pacify thee with needle points!

verses.sa: नार्यस्ते पत्न्यो लोम विचिन्वन्तु मनीषया। देवानां पत्न्यो दिशः सूचीभिः शम्यन्तु त्वा॥
verses.tr: nāryaste patnyo loma vicinvantu manīṣayā devānāṃ patnyo diśaḥ sūcībhiḥ śamyantu tvā
verses.en: May married dames of human birth skilfully separate thy hair: The Regions, Consorts of the Gods, pacify thee with needle points!

verses.sa: रजता हरिणीः सीसा युजो युज्यन्ते कर्मभिः। अश्वस्य वाजिनस्त्वचि सिमाः शम्यन्तु शम्यन्तीः॥
verses.tr: rajatā hariṇīḥ sīsā yujo yujyante karmabhiḥ aśvasya vājinastvaci simāḥ śamyantu śamyantīḥ
verses.en: They, made of silver, gold, and lead, are used as helpers in the work. As lines on the strong Courser's skin may they console and give thee rest.

verses.sa: कुविदङ्ग यवमन्तो यवञ्चिद्यथा दान्त्यनुपूर्वं वियूय। इहेहैषां कृणुहि भोजनानि ये बर्हिषो नम उक्तिं यजन्ति॥
verses.tr: kuvidaṅga yavamanto yavañcidyathā dāntyanupūrvaṃ viyūya ihehaiṣāṃ kṛṇuhi bhojanāni ye barhiṣo nama uktiṃ yajanti
verses.en: What then? As men whose fields are full of barley, etc, as in

verses.sa: कस्त्वा छ्यति कस्त्वा विशास्ति कस्ते गात्राणि शम्यति। क उ ते शमिता कविः॥
verses.tr: kastvā chyati kastvā viśāsti kaste gātrāṇi śamyati ka u te śamitā kaviḥ
verses.en: Who flays thee? Who dissects thee? Who prepares thy limbs for sacrifice? Who is the Sage that slaughters thee?

verses.sa: ऋतवस्त ऋतुथा पर्व शमितारो वि शासतु। संवत्सरस्य तेजसा शमीभिः शम्यन्तु त्वा॥
verses.tr: ṛtavasta ṛtuthā parva śamitāro vi śāsatu saṃvatsarasya tejasā śamībhiḥ śamyantu tvā
verses.en: In due time let the seasons as thy Slaughterers divide thy joints, And with the splendour of the Year sacrifice thee with holy rites.

verses.sa: अर्धमासाः परूंषि ते मासा आ च्छ्यन्तु शम्यन्तः। अहोरात्राणि मरुतो विलिष्टं सूदयन्तु ते॥
verses.tr: ardhamāsāḥ parūṃṣi te māsā ā cchyantu śamyantaḥ ahorātrāṇi maruto viliṣṭaṃ sūdayantu te
verses.en: Let the Half-months and let the Months, while sacrificing, flay thy limbs: Let Day and Night and Maruts mend each fault in sacrificing thee.

verses.sa: दैव्या अध्वर्यवस्त्वा च्छ्यन्तु वि च शासतु। गात्राणि पर्वशस्ते सिमाः कृण्वन्तु शम्यन्तीः॥
verses.tr: daivyā adhvaryavastvā cchyantu vi ca śāsatu gātrāṇi parvaśaste simāḥ kṛṇvantu śamyantīḥ
verses.en: Let the divine Adhvaryus flay thy body and dissect thy frame, And let the sacrificing lines prepare thy members joint by joint.

verses.sa: द्यौस्ते पृथिव्यन्तरिक्षं वायुश्छिद्रं पृणातु ते। सूर्यस्ते नक्षत्रैः सह लोकं कृणोतु साधुया॥
verses.tr: dyauste pṛthivyantarikṣaṃ vāyuśchidraṃ pṛṇātu te sūryaste nakṣatraiḥ saha lokaṃ kṛṇotu sādhuyā
verses.en: May Sky, Earth, Air; and W-ind simply each failing and defect of thine.: May Surya with the Stars of heaven duly prepare a world for thee.

verses.sa: शं ते परेभ्यो गात्रेभ्यः शमस्त्ववरेभ्यः। शमस्थभ्यो मज्जभ्यः शम्वस्तु तन्वै तव॥
verses.tr: śaṃ te parebhyo gātrebhyaḥ śamastvavarebhyaḥ śamasthabhyo majjabhyaḥ śamvastu tanvai tava
verses.en: Well be it with thine upper parts, well be it with the parts below! Well be it; with thy bones and with thy marrow and with all thy frame]

verses.sa: कः स्विदेकाकी चरति क उ स्विज्जायते पुनः। किं स्विद्धिमस्य भेषजं किम्वावपनं महत्॥
verses.tr: kaḥ svidekākī carati ka u svijjāyate punaḥ kiṃ sviddhimasya bheṣajaṃ kimvāvapanaṃ mahat
verses.en: Who moveth singly? Etc, as in verse 9.

verses.sa: सूर्य एकाकी चरति चन्द्रमा जायते पुनः। अग्निर्हिमस्य भेषजं भूमिरावपनं महत्॥
verses.tr: sūrya ekākī carati candramā jāyate punaḥ agnirhimasya bheṣajaṃ bhūmirāvapanaṃ mahat
verses.en: The Sun moves singly, etc., as in verse ft.

verses.sa: किं स्वित्सूर्यसमं ज्योतिः किं समुद्रसमं सरः। किं स्वित्पृथिव्यै वर्षीयः कस्य मात्रा न विद्यते॥
verses.tr: kiṃ svitsūryasamaṃ jyotiḥ kiṃ samudrasamaṃ saraḥ kiṃ svitpṛthivyai varṣīyaḥ kasya mātrā na vidyate
verses.en: What lustre is like Surya's light? What lake is equal to the# Sea li What is more spacious than the Earth? What thing is that which naught can mete?

verses.sa: ब्रह्म सूर्यसमं ज्योतिर्द्यौः समुद्रसमं सरः। इन्द्रः पृथिव्यै वर्षीयान् गोस्तु मात्रा न विद्यते॥
verses.tr: brahma sūryasamaṃ jyotirdyauḥ samudrasamaṃ saraḥ indraḥ pṛthivyai varṣīyān gostu mātrā na vidyate
verses.en: Brahma is lustre like the Sun. Heaven is a flood to match the Sea. Indra is vaster than the Earth. Beyond all measure is the Cow.

verses.sa: पृच्छामि त्वा चितये देवसख यदि त्वमत्र मनसा जगन्थ। येषु विष्णुस्त्रिषु पदेष्वेष्टस्तेषु विश्वं भुवनमा विवेशा३॥
verses.tr: pṛcchāmi tvā citaye devasakha yadi tvamatra manasā jagantha yeṣu viṣṇustriṣu padeṣveṣṭasteṣu viśvaṃ bhuvanamā viveśā3
verses.en: Friend of the Godsa I ask, for information, if thou in spirit hast obtained the knowledge, Hath Vishnu this whole Universe pervaded in the three steps wherein the God is worshipped?

verses.sa: अपि तेषु त्रिषु पदेष्वस्मि येषु विश्वं भुवनमा विवेश। सद्यः पर्येमि पृथिवीमुत द्यामेकेनाङ्गेन दिवो अस्य पृष्ठम्॥
verses.tr: api teṣu triṣu padeṣvasmi yeṣu viśvaṃ bhuvanamā viveśa sadyaḥ paryemi pṛthivīmuta dyāmekenāṅgena divo asya pṛṣṭham
verses.en: I also am in those three steps of Vishnu wherewith this Universe he permeated. The earth and heaven I circle in a moment and this heaven summit with a single organ.

verses.sa: केष्वन्तः पुरुष आ विवेश कान्यन्तः पुरुषे अर्पितानि। एतद्ब्रह्मन्नुप वल्हामसि त्वा किं स्विन्नः प्रति वोचास्यत्र॥
verses.tr: keṣvantaḥ puruṣa ā viveśa kānyantaḥ puruṣe arpitāni etadbrahmannupa valhāmasi tvā kiṃ svinnaḥ prati vocāsyatra
verses.en: What are the things which Purusha hath entered? What things hath Purusha contained within him? This riddle we propound to thee, O Brahman. Why dost thou give no answer to my question

verses.sa: पञ्चस्वन्तः पुरुष आ विवेश तान्यन्तः पुरुषे अर्पितानि। एतत्त्वात्र प्रतिमन्वानो अस्मि न मायया भवस्युत्तरो मत्॥
verses.tr: pañcasvantaḥ puruṣa ā viveśa tānyantaḥ puruṣe arpitāni etattvātra pratimanvāno asmi na māyayā bhavasyuttaro mat
verses.en: Within five things hath Purusha found entrance: these Purusha hath within himself connected. This is the thought which I return in answer. Thou art not my superior in wisdom.

verses.sa: का स्विदासीत्पूर्वचित्तिः किं स्विदासीद् बृहद्वयः। का स्विदासीत्पिलिप्पिला का स्विदासीत्पिशङ्गिला॥
verses.tr: kā svidāsītpūrvacittiḥ kiṃ svidāsīd bṛhadvayaḥ kā svidāsītpilippilā kā svidāsītpiśaṅgilā
verses.en: What was the antecedent thought etc., as in verse 11,

verses.sa: द्यौरासीत्पूर्वचित्तिरश्व आसीद् बृहद्वयः। अविरासीत्पिलिप्पिला रात्रिरासीत्पिशङ्गिला॥
verses.tr: dyaurāsītpūrvacittiraśva āsīd bṛhadvayaḥ avirāsītpilippilā rātrirāsītpiśaṅgilā
verses.en: Heaven was the antecedent thought, etc., as in

verses.sa: का ईमरे पिशङ्गिला का ईं कुरुपिशङ्गिला। क ईमास्कन्दमर्षति क ईं पन्थां वि सर्पति॥
verses.tr: kā īmare piśaṅgilā kā īṃ kurupiśaṅgilā ka īmāskandamarṣati ka īṃ panthāṃ vi sarpati
verses.en: Who, tell me, is the yellowish she? Who is the darkly yellowish? Who moves with rapid spring and bound? Who glides and winds along the path?

verses.sa: अजारे पिशङ्गिला श्वावित्कुरुपिशङ्गिला। शश आस्कन्दमर्षत्यहिः पन्थां वि सर्पति॥
verses.tr: ajāre piśaṅgilā śvāvitkurupiśaṅgilā śaśa āskandamarṣatyahiḥ panthāṃ vi sarpati
verses.en: The she-goat, Sir, is yellowish, dark-yellowish is the porcupine. The hare moves swift with leap and bound: the snake creeps winding on the path.

verses.sa: कत्यस्य विष्ठाः कत्यक्षराणि कति होमासः कतिधा समिद्धः। यज्ञस्य त्वा विदथा पृच्छमत्र कति होतार ऋतुशो यजन्ति॥
verses.tr: katyasya viṣṭhāḥ katyakṣarāṇi kati homāsaḥ katidhā samiddhaḥ yajñasya tvā vidathā pṛcchamatra kati hotāra ṛtuśo yajanti
verses.en: How many different forms hath this, how many syllables, burnt-oblations, brands for kindling? Here, of the rites of siicrifice I ask thee. Hew many Hotars in due season worship?

verses.sa: षडस्य विष्ठाः शतमक्षराण्यशीतिर्होमाः समिधो ह तिस्रः। यज्ञस्य ते विदथा प्र ब्रवीमि सप्त होतार ऋतुशो यजन्ति॥
verses.tr: ṣaḍasya viṣṭhāḥ śatamakṣarāṇyaśītirhomāḥ samidho ha tisraḥ yajñasya te vidathā pra bravīmi sapta hotāra ṛtuśo yajanti
verses.en: Sixfold its form, its syllables a hundred, eighty burnt-offerings, just three brands for kindling. To thee I tell the rites of sacrificing. Seven Hotars worship in appointed season.

verses.sa: को अस्य वेद भुवनस्य नाभिं को द्यावापृथिवी अन्तरिक्षम्। कः सूर्यस्य वेद बृहतो जनित्रं को वेद चन्द्रमसं यतोजाः॥
verses.tr: ko asya veda bhuvanasya nābhiṃ ko dyāvāpṛthivī antarikṣam kaḥ sūryasya veda bṛhato janitraṃ ko veda candramasaṃ yatojāḥ
verses.en: Who knoweth this world's central point? Who knoweth the heaven, the earth, and the wide air between them? Who knows the birthplace of the mighty Surya? Who knows the Moon, whence he was generated?

verses.sa: वेदाहमस्य भुवनस्य नाभिं वेद द्यावापृथिवी अन्तरिक्षम्। वेद सूर्यस्य बृहतो जनित्रमथो वेद चन्द्रमसं यतोजाः॥
verses.tr: vedāhamasya bhuvanasya nābhiṃ veda dyāvāpṛthivī antarikṣam veda sūryasya bṛhato janitramatho veda candramasaṃ yatojāḥ
verses.en: I know the centre of the world about us. I know heaven,. earth, and the wide air between them. I know the birthplace of the mighty Surya. I know the Moon, whence he was generated.

verses.sa: पृच्छामि त्वा परमन्तं पृथिव्याः पृच्छामि यत्र भुवनस्य नाभिः। पृच्छामि त्वा वृष्णो अश्वस्य रेतः पृच्छामि वाचः परमं व्योम॥
verses.tr: pṛcchāmi tvā paramantaṃ pṛthivyāḥ pṛcchāmi yatra bhuvanasya nābhiḥ pṛcchāmi tvā vṛṣṇo aśvasya retaḥ pṛcchāmi vācaḥ paramaṃ vyoma
verses.en: I ask thee of the earth's extremest limit, where is the centre of the world, I ask thee. I ask thee of the Stallion's genial humour,. I ask of highest heaven where Speech abideth.

verses.sa: इयं वेदिः परो अन्तः पृथिव्या अयं यज्ञो भुवनस्य नाभिः। अयं सोमो वृष्णो अश्वस्य रेतो ब्रह्मायं वाचः परमं व्योम॥
verses.tr: iyaṃ vediḥ paro antaḥ pṛthivyā ayaṃ yajño bhuvanasya nābhiḥ ayaṃ somo vṛṣṇo aśvasya reto brahmāyaṃ vācaḥ paramaṃ vyoma
verses.en: This altar is the earth's extremest limit; this sacrifice of ours is the world's centre. This Soma is the Stallion's genial humour, this Brahman highest heaven where Speech abideth.

verses.sa: सुभूः स्वयम्भूः प्रथमोऽन्तर्महत्यर्णवे। दधे ह गर्भमृत्वियं यतो जातः प्रजापतिः॥
verses.tr: subhūḥ svayambhūḥ prathamo'ntarmahatyarṇave dadhe ha garbhamṛtviyaṃ yato jātaḥ prajāpatiḥ
verses.en: The Strong, the Self-existent One, the First, within the mighty flood Laid down the timely embryo from which Prajapati was born.

verses.sa: होता यक्षत्प्रजापतिं सोमस्य महिम्नः। जुषतां पिबतु सोमं होतर्यज॥
verses.tr: hotā yakṣatprajāpatiṃ somasya mahimnaḥ juṣatāṃ pibatu somaṃ hotaryaja
verses.en: Let the Hotar sacrifice to! Prajapati from the Mahiman-Soma. Let him accept. Let him drink the Soma. Hotar, sacrifice.

verses.sa: प्रजापते न त्वदेतान्यन्यो विश्वा रूपाणि परि ता बभूव। यत्कामास्ते जुहुमस्तन्नो अस्तु वयं स्याम पतयो रयीणाम्॥
verses.tr: prajāpate na tvadetānyanyo viśvā rūpāṇi pari tā babhūva yatkāmāste juhumastanno astu vayaṃ syāma patayo rayīṇām
verses.en: Prajapati, thou only, etc., as in
